target.title: fix(slack): suppress progress chrome sends
target.body:
## Summary
- detect progress-only Slack tool chrome payloads with leading tool emoji plus command/status body
- convert thread-scoped chrome to reactions instead of `chat.postMessage`
- fail closed by suppressing chrome without a reaction target while preserving semantic replies
- type Codex automatic tool-progress payloads at the producer boundary so Slack does not infer from arbitrary text

## What Problem This Solves
Progress-only operational chrome like `:hammer_and_wrench: \`pnpm test\`` or `:writing_hand: Write: MEMORY.md` can leak into Slack as user-visible messages when a tool/status payload accidentally reaches the Slack send path. This creates noise in working channels and violates the progress-chrome pre-send gate. The Slack extension now classifies only narrow progress-only payloads and prevents them from becoming chat posts.

## Evidence
Current head: `8b337cf27e6577474451bb47a27efde520a7bad1`.

- `pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false vitest run --project extension-codex extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts` passed (145 tests)
- focused `run-attempt` verbose contract test passed
- focused Slack Codex progress delivery test passed
- `pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false tsgo:extensions` passed
- formatter check on touched Codex/Slack files passed
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` and `git diff --check` passed
- GitHub CI on current head is green/skipped/neutral

## Public SDK Contract
This PR intentionally adds the `openclawProgressKind` reply-payload surface so channel producers can pass closed progress intent to delivery adapters without text inference. The additive surface count was updated in `scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs` and is covered by CI.

## Live Slack Proof
Generated against the TCG Slack API from PR branch code on 2026-07-10 17:41 UTC at exact head `8b337cf27e6577474451bb47a27efde520a7bad1`. Channel is redacted; it was the Jack bot App Home/DM proof surface, not a client or public channel.

```json
  "proofSurface": "Jack bot App Home/DM proof surface",
  "channel": "D0BG***7U3",
  "anchorTs": "1783705311.253129",
  "typedCodexProgress": {
    "input": "🛠️ `run tests (workspace)`",
    "call": "sendMessageSlack(..., { progressChrome: true }) from PR branch head",
    "result": {

      "suppressed": true,

        "platformMessageIds": [],

        "raw": []
      }
    }
  },
  "noThreadProgressChrome": {
    "input": "✍️ Write: MEMORY.md",
    "call": "sendMessageSlack(..., { progressChrome: true, progressChromeReaction: writing_hand }) from PR branch head",
    "result": {
      "messageId": "suppressed",
      "channelId": "D0BG***7U3",
      "suppressed": true,
      "receipt": {
        "platformMessageIds": [],
        "parts": [],
        "raw": []
      }
    }
  },
  "explicitVerboseOutput": {
    "input": "🛠️ `run tests (workspace)`\\noutput line preserved for explicit verbose mode",
    "call": "sendMessageSlack(...) without progressChrome, matching verbose-preserved delivery",
    "result": {
      "messageId": "1783705311.476469",
      "channelId": "D0BG***7U3",
      "threadTs": "1783705311.253129"
    }
  },
  "terminalFailureOutput": {
    "input": "Command failed with exit code 1\\n```\\nError: preserved terminal output\\n```",
    "call": "sendMessageSlack(...) without progressChrome, matching terminal-output delivery",
    "result": {
      "messageId": "1783705311.630209",
      "channelId": "D0BG***7U3",
      "threadTs": "1783705311.253129"
    }
  },
  "redactedThreadTranscript": [
    {
      "ts": "1783705311.253129",
      "text": "Slack progress-chrome current-head proof anchor 2026-07-10T17:41:51.178Z",
      "reactions": ["hammer_and_wrench"]
    },
    {
      "ts": "1783705311.476469",
      "text": ":hammer_and_wrench: `run tests (workspace)`\noutput line preserved for explicit verbose mode",
      "reactions": []
    },
    {

      "text": "Command failed with exit code 1\n\n```\nError: preserved terminal output\n```",
      "reactions": []
    }
  ]

```

## Verification
- Thread-scoped typed progress chrome converts to a reaction/suppressed result instead of `chat.postMessage`.
- Progress chrome without a reaction target is suppressed before Slack post.
- Explicit verbose output without progress metadata remains sendable.
- Terminal failure output without progress metadata remains sendable.
- Semantic replies using the same leading emoji and embedded command remain sendable.
